ResearchProjectDef.label: meat prepping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn culinary techniques to treat and prep pungent marine meats such as shark and kraken flesh to make them palatable and safe to eat.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->discovered how to leech offensive odors and tough compounds out of pungent ocean meats
subject_story->turned unpalatable shark and kraken flesh into delicious meals for the crew

ResearchProjectDef.label: sea fats rendering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to render down rich fats and tissues from shark and kraken meat at a biofuel refinery to produce chemfuel.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->extracted rich, combustible oils by rendering down shark and kraken tissue
subject_story->refined ocean predator fats into valuable chemfuel
